priorityList: Cast Reaver's Glaive if you do not have the Rending Strike or Glaive Flurry buffs active to initiate the Aldrachi cycle.
If Rending Strike and Glaive Flurry are active, prioritize Death Sweep or Annihilation (Chaos Strike if not in Meta) to consume these buffs.
Cast Metamorphosis if Eye Beam is on cooldown and you have recently used Death Sweep/Blade Dance.
Cast Eye Beam on cooldown to trigger Demonic and set up for Essence Break.
Cast Essence Break immediately after Eye Beam while in Metamorphosis, ensuring you have Fury for the window.
Cast Death Sweep (if in Meta) or Blade Dance on cooldown.
Cast The Hunt on cooldown, preferably when Essence Break is not active and Reaver's Glaive buffs are clear.
Use Annihilation or Chaos Strike as your primary Fury spender, especially during the Essence Break debuff window.
Use Immolation Aura on cooldown to generate Fury and maintain Ragefire (if talented).
Use Felblade to generate Fury if you are below 40 Fury or to close the gap to your target.
Cast Vengeful Retreat on cooldown if using Initiative or Inertia talents to trigger their respective buffs.
Cast Fel Rush if Inertia is ready to be consumed and major cooldowns like Eye Beam are nearly ready.
Use Throw Glaive as a filler if Soulscar is talented and you have nothing else to press.
Use Arcane Torrent if you are low on Fury and all other generators are on cooldown.
